name: Naval Battle: Mission Commander
summary: An action-packed tactical strategy game developed by Gameloft for Java ME that modernizes the classic Battleship formula. Players take command of a naval fleet across a cinematic campaign, utilizing a variety of warships, submarines, and aircraft to hunt down enemy vessels. Featuring an engaging storyline with distinct characters, special weapon power-ups like airstrikes and radar sweeps, and polished 2D visuals, it elevates traditional grid-based naval combat into a dynamic military campaign.
